selection_rule.description: Generate one explicit master specification brief through constrained weighted sampling. The system samples from safe musical option pools, while user preference changes sampling weights and prompt word proportions.
selection_rule.randomness: Use a stored generation_seed so the selected parameters are reproducible for the same library item.
selection_rule.hard_rule: The final prompt must contain one explicit value for every parameter. Candidate pools are internal and must never be written as alternatives inside the generation prompt.

preference_to_prompt_word_ratio.description: The four style weights determine how many descriptor words from each dimension are inserted into the prompt.
